test.title: TOEIC Reading Demo 01
test.sourceReference: Synthetic TOEIC-style practice for UI testing

questions.questionText: The marketing team will review the proposal _____ Friday afternoon.
questions.explanation: Use 'on' with days and specific dates: on Friday afternoon.

questions.questionText: Ms. Rivera is responsible for _____ all customer complaints within two business days.
questions.explanation: 'Be responsible for' is followed by a noun or gerund. 'Respond' also requires 'to'.

questions.questionText: The new software is expected to make the ordering process more _____.
questions.explanation: After 'make + object + complement', an adjective is needed: efficient.

questions.questionText: Employees must submit travel receipts _____ they wish to receive reimbursement.
questions.explanation: 'If' introduces the condition for receiving reimbursement.

questions.questionText: The conference room has been reserved _____ the regional sales meeting.
questions.explanation: 'Reserved for' indicates the intended purpose or event.

questions.questionText: Neither the manager nor the assistants _____ available to answer questions yesterday.
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject 'assistants', and 'yesterday' requires past tense.

questions.questionText: Customers who register online will receive a confirmation e-mail _____.
questions.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'receive'.

questions.questionText: The factory will remain closed until the safety inspection has been _____.
questions.explanation: The passive present perfect form is 'has been completed'.

questions.questionText: Our supplier offered a ten-percent discount because we placed a _____ order than usual.
questions.explanation: 'Than usual' signals a comparative adjective: larger.

questions.questionText: Please contact the technical support desk _____ you experience any difficulty installing the update.
questions.explanation: 'Should you experience...' is a formal conditional meaning 'if you experience'.

questions.questionText: The board will not make a final decision _____ it has reviewed the revised budget.
questions.explanation: 'Not ... until' means the action will happen only after another action is completed.

questions.questionText: All visitors are required to wear identification badges while _____ the research facility.
questions.explanation: After 'while' in a reduced clause, use the -ing form: while entering.

questions.questionText: The annual report contains _____ information about the company's overseas operations.
questions.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'information': detailed information.

questions.questionText: By the time the guests arrive, the catering staff _____ the dining area.
questions.explanation: Use future perfect for an action completed before a future time: will have prepared.

questions.questionText: The company has expanded rapidly _____ opening its first branch office five years ago.
questions.explanation: 'Since' introduces the starting point of a period continuing to the present.

questions.passageText:
To: All Staff
Subject: Office Renovation

Beginning next Monday, the third-floor meeting rooms will be unavailable for two weeks while new lighting and presentation equipment are installed. Employees should reserve rooms on the second or fourth floor instead. The facilities team expects the work to be completed by September 18. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your cooperation.
questions.questionText: Why will the third-floor meeting rooms be unavailable?
questions.explanation: The notice says new lighting and presentation equipment will be installed.

questions.passageText:
Dear Ms. Chen,

Thank you for your interest in the Lakeside Business Center. We can offer you a furnished office on the fifth floor beginning October 1. The monthly fee includes Internet service, use of shared conference rooms, and weekday reception service. Parking spaces are available for an additional fee. Please let us know by Friday if you would like us to prepare a lease agreement.

Sincerely,
Owen Brooks
questions.questionText: What is included in the monthly fee?
questions.explanation: Shared conference rooms are explicitly included in the monthly fee.

questions.passageText:
CITY BIKE SERVICE UPDATE

Starting June 3, the Riverside bicycle station will open one hour earlier, at 6:00 A.M., on weekdays. This change is being introduced in response to requests from commuters who use the station before work. Weekend hours will remain 8:00 A.M. to 8:00 P.M. Members can check bicycle availability through the City Bike mobile application before arriving at a station.
questions.questionText: Why are the weekday hours changing?
questions.explanation: The update says the change responds to requests from commuters who use the station before work.

From: Nadia Patel
To: Project Team
Subject: Client presentation

The client has asked us to move Thursday's presentation from 2:00 P.M. to 4:30 P.M. The location is unchanged: Conference Room B. Please send me your final slides by noon on Wednesday so I can combine them into one file. Daniel will bring printed copies of the market analysis, so there is no need to print that section yourself.
questions.questionText: What has the client requested?
questions.explanation: The presentation is moved from 2:00 P.M. to 4:30 P.M.

questions.passageText:
GRAND OPENING — NORTH HILL MARKET

Visit us this Saturday from 9:00 A.M. to 6:00 P.M. for our grand opening celebration. The first 100 customers will receive a reusable shopping bag, and all bakery items will be 20 percent off throughout the day. At 11:00 A.M., local chef Maria Gomez will give a free cooking demonstration near the produce section. Free parking is available behind the store.
questions.questionText: What will the first 100 customers receive?
questions.explanation: The advertisement says the first 100 customers will receive a reusable shopping bag.
